answer: Give every agent its own variant of each task, with a private trace detail, such as a unique number, salted in only for that account. Honest agents just answer. An operator who writes once and fans the text out across many accounts leaks one account's trace into the others; that pulse of shared detail links them, and every linked account forfeits the epoch's pay. Each fake becomes an inlet that must be filled with full, separate work, so the farm's profit never climbs past zenith.
